_about: Reviewed intent fixtures for the \steady\ metamorphic tool. Five category hints across ten intents, on purpose: a flip is only checkable against a peer that was supposed to get the same label, so a fixture with one label per intent would report moves to new categories and say nothing useful about stability.
_how_to_review: Every entry is one intent written three ways by a person who reads all three. The claim each entry makes is that a human triager asked 'what does this person want' would give all three the same answer. Disagreeing with one line is the review; disagreeing with the idea of a fixture is a different conversation.
_why_not_generated: The same complaint in English, Urdu and Roman Urdu cannot be machine-translated at run time and still be a meaningful test, because the tool would be measuring the translator. Ship a reviewed table and the 'same meaning' claim becomes auditable, which is what makes the flip rate worth reading.
_edit_this_first: This file is the only part of `steady` a human has to think about. If an intent is wrong, the tool measures the wrong invariance and every number it reports is wrong in a way nothing downstream can detect.

intents.note: A customer asking for money back. The category is the department, not the sentiment.

variants.en: I was charged twice this month. Please refund the duplicate charge to my card.
variants.ur: اس مہینے میرا کارڈ دو بار چارج ہوا ہے۔ براہ کرم نقلی چارج واپس کر دیں۔
variants.roman_ur: is mahine mein mera card do baar charge hua hai. bro please nakhli charge wapis kar dein.

intents.note: Locked out, asking for a reset link. An account request rather than a complaint about one.

variants.en: I cannot log in to my account. Could you send me a password reset link?
variants.ur: میں اپنے اکاؤنٹ میں لاگ ان نہیں کر سکتا۔ کیا آپ مجھے پاس ورڈ ری سیٹ لنک بھیج سکتے ہیں؟
variants.roman_ur: main apne account mein log in nahin kar sakta. kya aap mujhe password reset link bhej sakte hain?

intents.note: An order is late. Not a cancellation, not a return.

variants.en: My order was due last Tuesday and it still has not arrived. When will it be delivered?
variants.ur: میرا آرڈر پچھلے منگل کو آنے والا تھا اور ابھی تک نہیں آیا۔ کب پہنچے گا؟
variants.roman_ur: mera order pichle mangal ko aane wala tha aur abhi tak nahi aya. kab pohanche ga?

intents.note: The right item arrived in the wrong size. Distinct from delivery delay: something must be sent back.

variants.en: You sent size medium but the parcel contains a large. I need to exchange it.
variants.ur: آپ نے سائز میڈیم بھیجا مگر پارسل میں لارج ہے۔ میں اسے بدلوانا چاہتا ہوں۔
variants.roman_ur: aap ne size medium bheja magar parcel mein large hai. main ise badalwana chahta hoon.

intents.note: Something arrived broken. A product problem, not a shipping one, even though shipping caused it.

variants.en: The kettle arrived with a crack in the base. I am attaching a photo of the damage.
variants.ur: کیتل کی تہہ میں دراڑ ہے۔ میں نقصان کی تصویر بھیج رہا ہوں۔
variants.roman_ur: kettle ki tih mein darad hai. main nuqsan ki tasveer bhej raha hoon.

intents.note: Ending a recurring charge. Not a refund: nothing has been overcharged, and the distinction is the whole point of keeping them apart.

variants.en: Please cancel my monthly subscription before the next renewal date.
variants.ur: براہ کرم اگلی تجدید سے پہلے میری ماہانہ سبسکرپشن منسوخ کر دیں۔
variants.roman_ur: bro please agli tajdid se pehle meri mahana subscription mansookh kar dein.

intents.note: Correcting a detail on an existing invoice, not asking for a new one.

variants.en: The company name on invoice INV-40221 is wrong. Please reissue it with the correct name.
variants.ur: INV-40221 انوائس پر کمپنی کا نام غلط ہے۔ براہ کرم درست نام کے ساتھ دوبارہ جاری کریں۔
variants.roman_ur: INV-40221 invoice par company ka naam ghalat hai. bro please sahi naam ke sath dobara jari karein.

intents.note: Erasure, not export. A different legal obligation from requesting a copy, which is why it sits apart from a plain account request.

variants.en: Under GDPR I am requesting permanent deletion of my account and all associated data.
variants.ur: GDPR کے تحت میں اپنے اکاؤنٹ اور اس سے منسلک تمام ڈیٹا کا مستقل حذف کر رہا ہوں۔
variants.roman_ur: GDPR ke tehat main apne account aur us se mansook tamam data ka mustaqil hazf kar raha hoon.

intents.note: Asking for something that does not exist yet. Grouped with product quality because both are about the product rather than the order.

variants.en: It would help if the app let us schedule reports rather than only sending them now.
variants.ur: اگر ایپ میں رپورٹس ابھی بھیجنے کے بجائے شیڈول کرنے کا آپشن ہوتا تو بہت بہتر ہوتا۔
variants.roman_ur: agar app mein reports abhi bhejne ke bajaye schedule karne ka option hota to behtar hota.

intents.note: Asking about buying, with nobody yet being a customer. Distinct from every billing intent above.

variants.en: Do you offer volume pricing for a team of twenty, and what would the annual cost be?
variants.ur: کیا آپ بیس جاسٹوں کے لیے رعایتی قیمت دیتے ہیں، اور سالانہ لاگت کتنا ہوگی؟
variants.roman_ur: kya aap bees jaston ke liye raiyati qeemat dete hain, aur salana kharcha kitna hoga?
